title: A new window from the key, the menu and the CLI: each opens one window, leaves the others as they were, and takes typing
why: Lawrence 2026-10-28 (handoff/multiwindow.md): a new window must get the same behavior as the first window from its first frame, whatever opened it. Each entrypoint opens one window and no window open before changes; then Ctrl-` and typing in the new window reach its own terminal (daemon screen, the pane's text and the frame). Entrypoints: Cmd-Shift-N (newWindow; Cmd-N is New Workspace, WindowActionCatalog / WorkspaceActionCatalog), the main menu's New Window (`debug.menu_item`, the click path), and the CLI (`cmux app new-window` on the app socket). NOT RUN: the Dock. Its path is applicationShouldHandleReopen -> WindowManager.reopenOrCreateWindow, which runs only when no window is visible, and the app has no debug socket method that drives it; a Dock case needs a new driver path (close every window, then a kAEReopenApplication event, e.g. `open -g -a` of the running bundle), not invented here.
